300.body: Polish coal mining giant JSW to shed 4,200 jobs – 21% of its workforce – this year Oct 2, 2026 | Business , Energy & Climate Keep our news free from ads and paywalls by making a donation to support our work! Polish state-owned mining firm Jastrzębska Spółka Węglowa (JSW), which is the EU’s largest producer of coking coal and one of Poland’s biggest employers, has announced that it will cut over 4,000 jobs, 21% of its workforce, by the end of this year. Last year, Poland introduced a new law making it easier for coal companies to close mines and reduce their workforce. Polish state-owned mining giant JSW, the EU's largest producer of coking coal, has reported a record annual loss of 7.3bn zloty.

300.body: Economy Crude Oil Prices Fall as Europe Moves to Release Diesel Reserves Published 1 second ago on 03/10/2026 By Adedapo Adesanya By Adedapo Adesanya Crude oil prices contracted on Friday after European leaders agreed to President Donald ​Trump’s request to release diesel reserves to lower prices and reduce fuel imports from the United States. The G7 and its partners have agreed to release as much as 100 million barrels of emergency diesel and crude stocks over the next four months, putting government inventories into a fuel market that has been running short of refinery output for months. European countries had discussed releasing 50 million barrels of diesel while members of the International Energy Agency (IEA) would supply another 50 million barrels of crude.

500.title: Apple to tighten Mac privacy controls against AI agents after Meta Muse complaints
500.summary: Apple has said that it will introduce new privacy controls against artificial intelligence agents on its Mac computers following user complaints that Meta Platforms' Muse may have accessed private messages. In July, Meta scrapped Muse Image days after it was launched amid a backlash over privacy concerns , particularly because Muse was being automatically – and without consent – linked to Instagram accounts.
500.body: Apple has said that it will introduce new privacy controls against artificial intelligence agents on its Mac computers following user complaints that Meta Platforms' Muse may have accessed private messages. At the time, Meta chief global affairs officer Joel Kaplan said that Muse was safe, secure and private, and made sure that users were in control of “what it can access” – all qualities Meta offerings have been criticised for lacking in recent years. But user complaints have recently crept up and claim that Muse could access supposedly private user information, particularly messages. In July, Meta scrapped Muse Image days after it was launched amid a backlash over privacy concerns , particularly because Muse was being automatically – and without consent – linked to Instagram accounts.

500.title: Tokayev Seeks to Take Trump’s AI ‘Washington Model’ Global
500.summary: Donald Trump Tokayev Seeks to Take Trump’s AI ‘Washington Model’ Global October 3, 2026 Posted by Times of Central Asia 03 Oct 2026 Image: TCA, Aleksandr Potolitsyn Kazakhstan’s President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev has embraced the voluntary artificial intelligence accord signed by President Donald Trump and leaders of major U.S. technology companies as a model for wider international adoption.
500.body: Donald Trump Tokayev Seeks to Take Trump’s AI ‘Washington Model’ Global October 3, 2026 Posted by Times of Central Asia 03 Oct 2026 Image: TCA, Aleksandr Potolitsyn Kazakhstan’s President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev has embraced the voluntary artificial intelligence accord signed by President Donald Trump and leaders of major U.S. technology companies as a model for wider international adoption. Tokayev has termed this approach the “Washington Model,” arguing that it could eventually form the basis of a treaty under the auspices of the United Nations. Following expert consideration, Tokayev said the agreement signed in Washington could be considered by interested countries as a model for global adoption. Tokayev’s endorsement of the Washington Model also fits a broader pattern in his engagement with Trump.
